note: Read 2026-10-30 on gov.bb, the Government of Barbados's portal. A learner's licence may be had from 16 with a parent's consent; from 18 one may apply for a permanent licence to drive a private motor vehicle, after the regulation exam ($30.00 BDS, not held) and a driving test, applied for to the Licensing Authority. The licence's own fee and term aren't given on the page, so both are null. The identity card is the ids engine's.

sources.title: GOV.BB, Get a Driver Licence
sources.said: If you are at least 18 years of age you may apply for a permanent license to drive a private motor vehicle. ... You will need to apply in the prescribed format to the Licensing Authority.
